tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Diaz
professor.text: Conformity means behaving in ways that match what others in a group expect. It can influence how people dress, speak, or make choices. Some researchers believe conformity keeps society peaceful and organized. Others argue that it limits personal expression and original thinking. Think about your own experiences, what you've seen in school, media, or daily life. Do you believe conformity is mostly helpful or mostly harmful to individuals and society? Explain your opinion clearly.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I believe conformity helps maintain social harmony. When individuals conform to societal norms, it should reduce conflict and foster cooperation. This in turn leads to a more stable and cohesive community. I see this in my neighborhood, where everyone helps each other out.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I think conformity suppresses individuality. By always trying to fit in with the group, people may avoid expressing their own perspectives. This seems to happen in social media quite often, where posts often just sound like repetitions or echoes of others.
